crossRefs.note: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from…
Yahweh will be seen over them; and his arrow will go flash like lightning; and the Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet…

translations.web: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
translations.bsb: The tempest comes from its chamber, and the cold from the driving north winds.
translations.kjv: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
translations.asv: Out of the chamber of the south cometh the storm, And cold out of the north.
